issuesSummary: THREE-STAGE: Fundamental compositional mismatch. Prompt describes boy running down path toward market square with crowd standing with BACKS TURNED facing a wooden pole (focal point). Image shows boy at market stalls with villagers attending stalls and facing toward camera. Lukas holds elephant in wrong arm (right vs left). Child positioned center-right instead of left-center. Missing: wooden pole with hat, church tower, timber buildings, dirt path, proper crowd arrangement. Scene structure inverted from prompt intent.
